title: Kissed Crumbly Irish Potato Casserole
description: A jammy and crumbly Irish dish featuring ginger cordial and ferment-kimchi, this adventurous recipe is jain-friendly and perfect for a special occasion. It combines the flavors of Ireland with a spicy kick from the kimchi.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and chopped onions, and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the ginger cordial, oat milk, olive oil, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped kimchi to the potato mixture and stir to combine.
Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil and add the potato mixture.
Pour the ginger cordial mixture over the potatoes and smooth the top.
Sprinkle the grated carrots over the top of the casserole.
Top the casserole with the crushed oats and bake for 45 minutes.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
